definitions.explanation: Status indicating that a message, email, or document has not been read yet. Common in digital communication contexts.

examples.japanese: {未読|みどく}⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧100⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{未読|みどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ままにしておいた。
LINE⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未読|みどく}⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think ignoring LINE messages as unread is rude.

notes:
{未読|みどく} means "unread" — not yet read. In modern Japanese, it is used primarily in digital communication contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + {読|どく} (reading). The prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧～ is productive: ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧ (undecided), ⟦{未完成|みかんせい}→未完成：13066_mikansei⟧ (incomplete).

DIGITAL USAGE:
- {未読|みどく}⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧: unread email
- {未読|みどく}⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧: unread message
- {未読|みどく}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: unread notification
- {未読|みどく}⟦スルー→スルー：11575_suruu⟧ / {未読|みどく}⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧: deliberately leaving messages unread (socially significant in Japan)

TRADITIONAL USAGE:
- {未読|みどく}{本|ほん}: unread book
- {未読|みどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: unread paper/article

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧: already read (opposite) — especially known from LINE's ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧ notification
- {未読|みどく}: not yet read

CULTURAL NOTE:
On LINE, the ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧ indicator shows when a message has been read, making {未読|みどく}⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧ (deliberately not opening a message) a recognized social behavior distinct from ⟦{既読|きどく}→既読：06483_kidoku⟧⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧ (reading but not replying).
